Objective: Prove customer demand across multiple suppliers
Acceptance theme: A customer can buy from three suppliers in one checkout

Objective: Deliver reliably enough for repeat purchase
Acceptance theme: Every parcel has a carrier, waybill, status history and POD
A return is resolved with a refund and a customer communication
A supplier is verified, approved, publishes approved products and sees only its own data
Commission, refunds and payouts reconcile to the ledger

Objective: Operate within Tanzanian law and contracts
Acceptance theme: The platform can evidence consent, terms version, invoices and audit

Objective: Run the pilot with a small team
Acceptance theme: The team can run a pilot day without shadow spreadsheets

Objective: Produce evidence for scale, pivot or stop
Acceptance theme: Reports show demand, retention, delivery and unit economics by cohort
